title: Open / Giant

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Use image scale to interpret a title because exaggeration can make a production’s premise visually immediate.
strategic_value: The enormous figure and tiny opposing performer can make Giant memorable within the red-framed season family.
demonstration: A large man fills most of the poster while a small figure braces against the lower-right edge of the red Public band.
practical_value: Compare a conceptual scale contrast with the fixed campaign frame.

content_islands.name: Main figure
content_islands.spec: Let the oversized man extend across the picture and title areas.

content_islands.name: Small counterfigure
content_islands.spec: Place the tiny figure at lower right against the Public band, keeping production details at right.

reference_purposes.Expression: A large man fills most of the poster while a small figure braces against the lower-right edge of the red Public band.
